name: Luc Bursden
source:
[i]"An eternally poor doctor like you that just gets used and tossed away by all the adults in town has no right to act so pompous!"[/i]

[i]Calculating Youth[/i]

A boy that grew up in the same orphanage as Tilkett. He's spirited, cheerful, and eloquent, but working at a tavern has led to him picking up the adults' rougher way of speaking. Though he looks his age and can act childish at times, he's able to read a situation and act in whatever way benefits him.

He's constantly harsh with Tilkett, but deep down he adores him like an older brother.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/kaleido/english/characters/?page=luc]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
